prompt: Every hour on the hour until 13:00, send moxi1 from the nurse_station to ward_3, then to the lab, and back to the nurse_station.
why: A time trigger: a run starts on the hour, not when the previous one is done (0041 M6, clarification 14). 2.2 repeats a task when its last run ends, so a round followed by a wait drifts by the length of the round; a mission has no `every` clause (language reference: 'Missions'). The bound (13:00) is stated; the trigger is what stays out.
